blocks.text:
Event signals are emitted as a result of some user input, for instance a key press
or a mouse motion. Usually you don't handle these events directly. Instead, you use
a subclass of `Gtk::EventController`, such as `Gtk::EventControllerKey`
or `Gtk::GestureClick`. Event controllers can be added to a
widget with Gtk::Widget::add_controller().
blocks.zh: 事件信号（event signals）因用户输入而产生，例如按键或鼠标移动。通常你不需要直接处理这些事件，而是使用 Gtk::EventController 的子类，比如 Gtk::EventControllerKey 或 Gtk::GestureClick。事件控制器可以用 Gtk::Widget::add_controller() 添加到部件上。

blocks.text:
You might occasionally find it useful to handle events when there's something
you can't accomplish with normal signals. `Gtk::Button`,
for example, does not send mouse-pointer coordinates with its
`clicked` signal, but you could handle
Gtk::GestureClick::signal_pressed() if you needed this
information. Gtk::EventControllerKey::signal_key_pressed()
is often used to handle key-presses.
blocks.zh: 当常规信号无法满足需求时，直接处理事件偶尔会很有用。例如，Gtk::Button 的 clicked 信号不携带鼠标指针坐标；如果需要这个信息，可以处理 Gtk::GestureClick::signal_pressed()。处理按键则常用 Gtk::EventControllerKey::signal_key_pressed()。

blocks.text:
Some event controller signals behave slightly differently. The value returned from
the signal handler indicates whether it has fully "handled" the event. If the value
is `false` then gtkmm will pass the event on to the next
signal handler. If the value is `true` then no other signal handlers
will need to be called.
blocks.zh: 一些事件控制器信号的行为略有不同：信号处理函数的返回值用于指示事件是否已被完全「处理」。返回 false 时，gtkmm 会把事件继续传给下一个信号处理函数；返回 true 时，就不会再调用其他信号处理函数了。

blocks.text:
Handling an event doesn't affect the Widget's other signals. If you handle
Gtk::GestureClick::signal_pressed() for
`Gtk::Button`, you'll still be able to get the
`clicked` signal. They are emitted at (nearly) the same time.
blocks.zh: 处理事件不影响部件的其他信号。即使你为 Gtk::Button 处理了 Gtk::GestureClick::signal_pressed()，你仍然能收到它的 clicked 信号。这两个信号几乎在同一时刻发出。

blocks.text:
When the mouse is over the button and a mouse button is pressed,
on_button_press() will be called.
blocks.zh: 当鼠标位于按钮上方并按下鼠标按键时，on_button_press() 将被调用。

blocks.text:
The call to set_propagation_phase() is necessary in
this case because the `GtkButton` C class adds an event
controller, handling button clicks in the capture phase. `GtkButton`
claims the event, meaning that the event is not propagated in the bubble phase,
where event controllers handle events by default.
blocks.zh: 这个例子里必须调用 set_propagation_phase()，因为 C 语言的 GtkButton 类自带一个事件控制器，会在捕获阶段处理按钮点击。GtkButton 会认领该事件，也就是说事件不会进入冒泡阶段传播——而事件控制器默认正是在冒泡阶段处理事件的。

blocks.text:
By default, signal handlers that return `void` are called after
any previously-connected signal handlers. However, this can be a problem with
event signals that can stop event propagation by returning `true`.
For instance, the existing signal handlers, or the default signal handler, might return
`true` to stop other signal handlers from being called.
To specify that your signal handler should be called before the other signal handlers,
you can specify `false` for the `after` parameter.

returns `void`. For instance,
blocks.zh: 默认情况下，返回 void 的信号处理函数会在之前连接的信号处理函数之后被调用。但对可以通过返回 true 阻止事件继续传播的事件信号来说，这会出问题：已有的信号处理函数或默认信号处理函数可能返回 true，使你的信号处理函数得不到调用。要让你的信号处理函数在其他处理函数之前被调用，可以把 connect() 的 after 参数指定为 false。仅当信号处理函数返回 void 时，这个 connect() 参数才是可选的。例如：

blocks.text: The event is propagated between widgets in 3 phases.
blocks.zh: 事件在部件之间的传播分为 3 个阶段。

blocks.text: Capture phase - runs from the toplevel down to the event widget.
blocks.zh: 捕获阶段——从顶级窗口向下传递到事件部件。

blocks.text: Target phase - runs only on the event widget.
blocks.zh: 目标阶段——只在事件部件上执行。

blocks.text: Bubble phase - runs from the event widget up to the toplevel.
blocks.zh: 冒泡阶段——从事件部件向上回到顶级窗口。

blocks.text:
The [Input Handling](https://docs.gtk.org/gtk4/input-handling.html)
chapter in the GTK documentation describes user input handling in more detail.
blocks.zh: GTK 文档中的 Input Handling 一章（https://docs.gtk.org/gtk4/input-handling.html）更详细地描述了用户输入的处理。
